title: Ordering coffee
setting: You are in a busy cafe. Order a drink and something to eat.

turns.say: Hi there! What can I get for you today?
replies: I'd like a medium cappuccino, please.
Could I have a large latte, please?
Just a black coffee for me, thanks.

turns.say: Sure. Would you like that with regular milk or oat milk?
replies: Oat milk, please.
Regular milk is fine, thank you.
No milk for me, thanks.

turns.say: Anything to eat with that? We have fresh croissants and muffins.
replies: I'll have a chocolate croissant, please.
No thanks, just the coffee.
What muffins do you have today?

turns.say: Is that for here or to go?
replies: To go, please.
I'll have it here, thanks.
For here, please. I'm not in a hurry.

turns.say: That comes to six fifty. Would you like a receipt?
replies: No receipt, thank you. Can I pay by card?
Yes, please. Here is my card.
Here you go. Keep the change.

turns.say: Thanks! We'll call your name when it's ready. Have a great day!
replies: Thank you very much. You too!
Thanks, have a lovely day.
Great, thanks. See you tomorrow!

title: Hotel check-in
setting: You arrive at a hotel after a long trip. Check in politely.

turns.say: Good evening, and welcome to the Grand Hotel. How can I help you?
replies: Good evening. I have a reservation under the name Khan.
Hello, I'd like to check in, please.
Hi, I booked a room for two nights.

turns.say: Thank you, Mr Khan. I can see your booking. Could I see your passport, please?
replies: Of course, here you are.
Sure. One moment, it's in my bag.
Yes, certainly. Here is my passport.

turns.say: Perfect. You're in room 412, on the fourth floor. Would you like help with your luggage?
replies: No, thank you, I can manage.
Yes, please. That would be very kind.
That's very kind, but I only have one bag.

turns.say: Is there anything else you need?
replies: Could you tell me what time breakfast is served?
Is breakfast included in the price?
What's the Wi-Fi password, please?

turns.say: Breakfast is from seven to ten in the restaurant on the ground floor. Do you need a wake-up call?
replies: Yes, please. At half past six, if possible.
No, thank you. I'll set my own alarm.
That would be great. Could you call me at seven?

turns.say: Of course. Here is your key. Enjoy your stay!
replies: Thank you very much. Good night!
Thanks for your help. Have a good evening.
Great, thank you. I'm sure I will.

title: Asking for directions
setting: You are lost in a new city and need to find the train station.
phrases: Excuse me, could you tell me...?

turns.say: Hello! You look a bit lost. Can I help you?
replies: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the train station?
Yes, please. I'm looking for the central station.
Hi, I think I'm lost. Where is the station?

turns.say: Sure. Go straight along this road for about five minutes, then turn left at the traffic lights.
replies: Straight on, then left at the lights. Is that right?
Sorry, could you say that again, a bit slower?
Okay, so left at the traffic lights.

turns.say: That's right. After the lights, you'll see a big supermarket on your right.
replies: And then how far is the station from the supermarket?
Great. Is it far from there?
Okay, and what do I do after the supermarket?

turns.say: It's only two minutes from there. You can't miss it. It's a large red building.
replies: Wonderful. Is it far if I walk?
Thank you so much, that's really helpful.
A red building, got it. How long does it take on foot?

turns.say: About ten minutes in total. Or you can take the bus from the next stop.
replies: I think I'll walk. It's a nice day.
Where exactly is the bus stop?
Walking is fine, thank you.

turns.say: Have a safe trip!
replies: Thank you very much for your help. Goodbye!
Thanks again. Have a great day!
You've been very kind. Take care!

title: Job interview
setting: You are at an interview for a marketing role. Sound confident and clear.

turns.say: Good morning, and thank you for coming. Could you start by telling me a little about yourself?
replies: Good morning. I have five years of experience in marketing, mostly in social media.
Thank you for having me. I studied business and then worked in digital advertising.
I'm a creative marketer who enjoys turning data into good ideas.

turns.say: That's interesting. Why are you interested in this position?
replies: I admire your company's brand, and I'm looking for a role where I can grow.
This position matches my skills, and I like your focus on innovation.
I'd like to work with a larger team and take on more responsibility.

turns.say: What would you say is your greatest strength?
replies: My greatest strength is working well in a team.
I'm very organised, and I always meet my deadlines.
I'm a quick learner and I communicate clearly.

turns.say: And what is an area where you'd like to improve?
replies: I'm working on delegating tasks instead of doing everything myself.
I'd like to improve my public speaking, so I've joined a course.
Sometimes I focus too much on details, but I'm learning to prioritise.

turns.say: Can you tell me about a challenge you faced at work and how you handled it?
replies: Last year we had a tight deadline, so I organised the team and we finished on time.
A client was unhappy, so I listened carefully and offered a new plan.
Our budget was cut, so I found cheaper ways to reach the same goal.

turns.say: Thank you. Do you have any questions for us?
replies: Yes, could you tell me more about the company culture?
What are the next steps in the process?
Thank you. I'd like to ask what a typical day looks like in this role.

title: At the doctor's
setting: You don't feel well and visit a doctor. Describe how you feel.

turns.say: Good afternoon. Please take a seat. What seems to be the problem?
replies: I've had a headache and a sore throat for three days.
I don't feel well. I have a fever and I'm very tired.
I've had a terrible cough since the weekend.

turns.say: I see. Have you taken any medicine for it?
replies: I took some paracetamol, but it didn't help much.
No, I haven't taken anything yet.
Yes, I've been taking painkillers twice a day.

turns.say: Do you have any allergies that I should know about?
replies: No, I don't have any allergies.
Yes, I'm allergic to penicillin.
I'm allergic to nuts, but nothing else.

turns.say: Let me check your throat. Open wide, please. It looks a little red. I think you have an infection.
replies: Is it serious, doctor?
What do I need to do to get better?
Will I need antibiotics?

turns.say: Nothing to worry about. I'll prescribe some tablets. Take one twice a day after meals, and drink plenty of water.
replies: How long should I take them for?
Should I stay at home and rest?
When should I start to feel better?

turns.say: Take them for five days. If you don't feel better by then, come back and see me.
replies: Thank you, doctor. I'll do that.
That's clear, thanks for your help.
Thank you very much. Goodbye!

title: Booking a table by phone
setting: You phone a restaurant to book a table for a special evening.
phrases: I'd like to book a table.

turns.say: Good afternoon, Bella Italia. How may I help you?
replies: Good afternoon. I'd like to book a table for Saturday evening, please.
Hello, could I reserve a table for tonight?
Hi, I'd like to make a reservation for this Friday.

turns.say: Certainly. How many people will there be?
replies: A table for four, please.
There will be six of us.
Just two people, please.

turns.say: And what time would you like to come?
replies: Around half past seven, if possible.
Eight o'clock would be perfect.
Do you have anything available at seven?

turns.say: I'm afraid we're full at half past seven, but I could offer you a table at eight fifteen.
replies: Eight fifteen is fine, thank you.
That works for me. Please book it.
Could you check if there's anything earlier on Sunday?

turns.say: Lovely. Could I have your name and a contact number, please?
replies: My name is Khan. That's K-H-A-N.
It's Ali Khan, and my number is zero seven eight one two three four.
Sure. The name is Khan, and I can give you my mobile number.

turns.say: Thank you. Is it a special occasion?
replies: Yes, it's my wife's birthday, so a quiet table would be lovely.
It's our anniversary, actually.
No, it's just a nice evening out.

title: Small talk at a party
setting: You meet someone new at a friend's party. Keep the conversation going.

turns.say: Hi! I don't think we've met. I'm Alex.
replies: Hi Alex, nice to meet you. I'm Sara.
Hello! I'm Sara. Great party, isn't it?
Nice to meet you, Alex. My name is Sara.

turns.say: So how do you know the host?
replies: We used to work together a few years ago.
We studied together at university.
She's my neighbour, actually.

turns.say: Oh nice. And what do you do now?
replies: I work as a graphic designer for a small company.
I'm a teacher. I teach English at a high school.
I'm an engineer, but I'm thinking about changing careers.

turns.say: That sounds interesting! Do you enjoy it?
replies: Yes, I really do. Every day is different.
Most days, yes, although it can be stressful sometimes.
I love it. What about you?

turns.say: I'm in finance, so it's mostly numbers. What do you like to do in your free time?
replies: I like hiking and cooking when I have time.
I spend my weekends reading and watching football.
I love travelling. I'm planning a trip next month.

turns.say: That sounds great. Well, it was lovely talking to you. Let's keep in touch!
replies: It was lovely talking to you too. Let's keep in touch!
Likewise! Enjoy the rest of the party.
Nice meeting you, Alex. See you around!

title: Returning an item
setting: You bought a jacket that doesn't fit. Politely ask for a refund or an exchange.

turns.say: Hello! Can I help you with anything today?
replies: Yes, I'd like to return this jacket, please.
Hi, I bought this jacket last week, but it doesn't fit.
Hello, could I exchange this for a different size?

turns.say: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have the receipt with you?
replies: Yes, I have the receipt right here.
I'm afraid I lost the receipt, but I paid by card.
Yes, here you are. I bought it on Monday.

turns.say: Thank you. Was there a problem with the jacket, or is it just the size?
replies: It's just the size. It's a little too tight.
The jacket is fine, but the sleeves are too long.
There's a small tear near the pocket.

turns.say: I see. Would you prefer a refund or an exchange for a different size?
replies: I'd prefer an exchange, please. Do you have a medium?
A refund would be great, if possible.
Could I exchange it for the same jacket in a larger size?

turns.say: We do have a medium in blue. Would you like to try it on?
replies: Yes, please. Where are the fitting rooms?
That would be perfect. May I try it on?
Blue is fine. I'll try it on, thank you.

turns.say: The fitting rooms are at the back. Let me know if you need anything else.
replies: Thank you so much for your help.
Thanks, that's very kind of you.
Great, I'll let you know. Thank you!

title: Airport check-in
setting: You are at the airport desk with your luggage.
phrases: Could I have a window seat?
How many bags can I take?

turns.say: Good morning. Where are you flying to today?
replies: Good morning. I'm flying to London.
Hello, I'd like to check in for the flight to Dubai.
Hi, I'm travelling to Istanbul this morning.

turns.say: May I see your passport and booking reference, please?
replies: Of course. Here is my passport and my booking reference.
Sure, one moment. My booking reference is on my phone.
Yes, here you are.

turns.say: Thank you. Do you have any bags to check in?
replies: Yes, I have one suitcase to check in.
No, I only have hand luggage.
I have two bags. How much do they weigh?

turns.say: Please put your suitcase on the scale. It's twenty-two kilos, which is fine. Would you like a window or an aisle seat?
replies: A window seat, please, if there is one.
I'd prefer an aisle seat, so I can stretch my legs.
Could I have a seat next to my friend, please?

turns.say: Here is your boarding pass. Boarding starts at ten thirty at gate fourteen.
replies: Thank you. Is the flight on time?
Which way is gate fourteen, please?
Sorry, what time does boarding start?

turns.say: The flight is on time. Have a pleasant flight!
replies: Thank you very much. Goodbye!
Thanks for your help. Have a nice day!
Great, thanks. See you!
